text_en: The Cyber Security Strategy 2025-2028 of the Republic of North Macedonia is a strategic document whose aim is, through a range of activities and measures, to provide a secure, resilient and trustworthy digital environment that makes the Republic of North Macedonia a safe place for online activity and work, with advanced human an

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The Cyber Security Strategy 2025-2028 will be implemented over four years, from 2025 to 2028, in accordance with the measures and tasks defined in the Action Plan, which is an integral document of the Strategy.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: Funds for implementing and monitoring the Strategy will be provided within the budget of the institution leading the activity, but where permitted also using donor funds for support.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The implementation of the Strategy, its follow-up and monitoring are the responsibility of MDT.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: In the specific area of cyber security, no existing strategic planning documents have been identified, with the exception of the National Cyber Security Strategy 2018-2022.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The Strategy supports this goal through developing a clear institutional framework, including forming a Cyber Security Sector in the Ministry of Digital Transformation, encouraging innovation and the use of artificial intelligence for managing cyber risks and protecting data, and providing a secure basis for developing startup e

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: In addition, the Strategy seeks to align activities related to cyber security with European Directives 2022/2555 and 2022/2557, and with the EU Regulation (881/2019, Cybersecurity Act).

speaker: Државен завод за ревизија
text_en: The findings of the State Audit Office of the Republic of North Macedonia, published in the report "Effectiveness of measures taken by competent authorities to protect critical information systems" of 2024, show significant shortcomings in the measures for protecting critical information systems.

speaker: Државен завод за ревизија
text_en: The audit established that institutions lack adequate legal frameworks to ensure full cyber security, because national legislation is still not aligned with the European Union NIS (2016) and NIS2 (2023) directives, which set minimum standards for cyber security.

speaker: Државен завод за ревизија
text_en: Although there was a national cyber security strategy until 2022, its implementation was not fully achieved.

speaker: Државен завод за ревизија
text_en: The report also points to the insufficient activity of the National Cyber Security Council, formed in 2019. The audit established that the Council, from its formation to the audit's reporting period, met only once.

speaker: Државен завод за ревизија
text_en: The audit gives recommendations for urgent reforms, including: aligning legislation with EU directives; improving coordination between institutions and creating stronger cyber security teams; continuous investment in training and capacity development, so as to avoid the potential risks of cyber attacks that could disrupt the fun

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: In the period 2019 to 2023 there were several initiatives to adopt a legal solution for cyber security, the last attempt being in 2023, through a published working version of a Law on Security of Network and Information Systems and Digital Transformation of September 2023, a document publicly available on ENER.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: At sector level, the energy, banking and public electronic communications networks and services sectors are the only ones with a sector legal framework that includes defining measures and controls related to information or cyber security, as well as supervision of their implementation by operator organisations in these sectors.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The country is already in its second year without a strategic document giving direction for improving resilience to cyber attacks and incidents.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The Ministry of Digital Transformation (hereinafter MDT), as successor to the former Ministry of Information Society and Administration, was established by the amendments to the Law on the Organisation and Work of State Administration Bodies, adopted on 10 June 2024 and published in Official Gazette no. 121/24.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: Of all the listed competences, the security of network and information systems is an entirely new competence, while the others were directly or indirectly part of the MIOA portfolio.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: Coordination between sectors remains a critical aspect for improvement, as does the lack of resources and teams for a rapid, expert and quality response after a cyber incident or during cyber attacks.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: Although national and sector legal frameworks for cyber security are developing towards alignment with EU directives, their implementation and updating related to the protection of critical infrastructure, digital services and cyber security in the public sector are lacking.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: Problems with coordination at national level and in most high-criticality sectors: weak coordination between the government and private sectors and international organisations is a critical challenge.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: Insufficient legal provisions: the existing legal framework needs to be upgraded and updated to cover modern cyber security challenges and ensure their implementation.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: Strengthening the legal framework. Adopting a legal solution dedicated to cyber security will allow defining obligations for implementing and supervising measures and controls to protect high-criticality sectors and the services and systems of the Government. This legal solution will allow the roles and functions in the National

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The main policy directions include strengthening national capacities through forming management structures such as the Cyber Security Sector and incident response teams (CSIRT); ensuring the security and resilience of critical infrastructure through risk management and public-private cooperation; advancing awareness and educatio

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The Government of the Republic of North Macedonia will develop a clear cyber security management structure to improve capabilities for prevention, stopping, detection, response and recovery from cyber threats and incidents.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The Republic of North Macedonia will commit to creating a robust national cyber security system by building a National Cyber Security Management Framework (NRUSB).

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The Strategy proposes that the Government integrate the National Cyber Security Council into the National Council for Digital Transformation of Society (NSDTO).

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The role of National Single Point of Contact will be performed by MDT.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: To define essential and important entities, the definition given in Article 2 of European Directive (EU) 2022/2555 is used.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The competences and cooperation of the National and Government CSIRT will be regulated by a new legal solution on cyber security and by amendments and alignment with existing EU and NATO legislation and good practice.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
text_en: The National Competent Authority for cyber security in the country is MDT.

speaker: Министерство за дигитална трансформација
